import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;
    static int maxN = 100000;
    static long[] fact = new long[maxN + 1];
    static long[] inv_fact = new long[maxN + 1];
    static long[] inv_num = new long[maxN + 1];

    static class Pair {
        long a, b;

        Pair(long a, long b) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
        }

        Pair() {
            this.a = 0;
            this.b = 0;
        }

        Pair add(Pair y) {
            return new Pair(add_mod(this.a + y.a), add_mod(this.b + y.b));
        }

        Pair multiply(Pair y) {
            long newA = (this.a * y.a) % mod;
            long newB = add_mod((this.a * y.b) % mod + (this.b * y.a) % mod);
            return new Pair(newA, newB);
        }
    }

    static int n, m;
    static Pair[] dp = new Pair[maxN + 1];
    static Pair[][] table = new Pair[maxN + 1][maxN + 1];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        fact[0] = 1;
        inv_fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxN; i++) {
            fact[i] = (long) i * fact[i - 1] % mod;
            inv_fact[i] = power(fact[i], mod - 2);
            inv_num[i] = power(i, mod - 2);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            dp[i] = new Pair();
        }
        dp[0] = new Pair(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Pair temp = dp[j - 1].multiply(dp[i - j]);
                long sumVal = add_mod(sum_func(j - 1) + sum_func(i - j));
                temp.b = add_mod((long) temp.b * (i + 1) % mod + (long) temp.a * sumVal % mod);
                temp.b = (temp.b * inv_num[i]) % mod;
                temp.a = (temp.a * (i + 1) % mod * inv_num[i]) % mod;
                dp[i] = dp[i].add(temp);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                table[i][j] = new Pair();
            }
        }

        table[0][0] = new Pair(1, 0);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int limit = Math.min(i, m);
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    table[i][j] = dp[i];
                } else {
                    for (int k = 0; k < j && k < i; k++) {
                        table[i][j] = table[i][j].add(dp[k].multiply(table[i - k - 1][j - k]));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = (table[n][m].b * fact[m]) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int add_mod(int x) {
        return x >= mod ? x - mod : x;
    }

    static long add_mod(long x) {
        return x >= mod ? x - mod : x;
    }

    static long sum_func(int x) {
        long val = (long) x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod;
        return val;
    }

    static long power(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
